records.note: Then the most expensive painting ever sold at auction; bought by Japanese industrialist Ryoei Saito from the Kramarsky family. The first-version portrait has not been publicly seen since the 1990s.
records.price_as_reported: $82,500,000 ($75 million, plus a 10 percent buyer's commission)

records.note: Misattributed to Rubens's assistant Jan van den Hoecke for more than two centuries and reattributed by Sotheby's in 2001; bought by Kenneth Thomson, it remains the highest price paid at auction for an Old Master painting.
records.source_name: Sotheby's, 'The History of Sotheby's Auction House'

records.note: The first painting to sell for more than $100 million at auction, breaking the record held since 1990 by Van Gogh's Portrait of Dr Gachet. Sold by the Greentree Foundation from the collection of Mr and Mrs John Hay Whitney, who had bought it in 1950 for $30,000.
records.source_name: Sotheby's, sale N07989 lot page (Property of the Greentree Foundation, from the Collection of Mr and Mrs John Hay Whitney)

records.note: The most expensive painting ever sold at auction. The last Leonardo in private hands, rediscovered in 2005 and consigned by the Dmitry Rybolovlev family trust, it was offered in Christie's Post-War and Contemporary Art Evening Sale.
records.source_name: Christie's press release, 'Christie's Sells Leonardo da Vinci's 500-Year-Old Masterpiece'

records.note: The first Impressionist painting to sell for more than $100 million at auction, and a record for Monet. Bought from the artist's dealer Paul Durand-Ruel in 1892 by Bertha Honoré Palmer and held by her family until this sale.
records.source_name: Sotheby's, 'Record-Breaking $110.7 Million Monet Leads Impressionist & Modern Art Evening Sale'

records.note: Bought from the Rothschild family for the Dutch nation: the Dutch State contributed €150 million, the Rembrandt Association €15 million and the Rijksmuseum Fund €10 million. It is now on permanent display at the Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam.
records.source_name: Guinness World Records, 'Most expensive painting by Rembrandt in private sale'

records.estimate: Estimate on request (reported as in excess of $13,000,000)
records.note: Bought from the artist's studio by Florence Knoll Bassett and exhibited in the Museum of Modern Art's 1998–99 Pollock retrospective. Phillips later reported that the 2024 purchaser defaulted on payment, and the work was re-offered in 2026, when it made $9.1 million with fees.
records.source_name: Phillips, Modern & Contemporary Art Evening Sale, 19 November 2024 (sale results listing)

records.estimate: Estimate on request (expected in the region of $150,000,000)
records.note: The second most expensive artwork ever sold at auction, and the most expensive work of modern art at auction. Sold from the collection of Leonard A. Lauder, who had owned it since 1985, in Sotheby's first evening sale at its new Breuer Building headquarters.
records.price_as_reported: $236,360,000 (with fees; most press reports round this to $236.4 million)
records.source_name: The Value, 'At US$236.3m, Klimt's Portrait of Elisabeth Lederer becomes the second most expensive work ever auctioned'

records.note: A new auction record for Van Gogh and the fourth-highest price ever paid for a painting at auction. Sold from the Blaquier-Arrieta Collection a day after a settlement with the heirs of publisher Samuel Fischer over the painting's 1936 sale; bought by dealer William Acquavella.
records.price_as_reported: $190,430,000 (with fees; The Art Newspaper, Reuters and Artnet News report the figure rounded, as $190.4 million with fees)
records.source_name: The Art Newspaper, 'Van Gogh painting sells for record $190m at Sotheby's following Nazi loot claims'

records.note: Consigned by Baroness Carmen Thyssen-Bornemisza, in whose family's collection the painting had been for more than 45 years; the posted result is more than double the low estimate.
records.price_as_reported: 47,830,000 USD — Sotheby's lot page states 'Lot Sold — 47,830,000 USD' and does not state whether buyer's premium is included; the basis is unresolved and the figure is recorded exactly as posted
records.source_name: Sotheby's, Modern Evening Auction lot page (lot 109)
